fact_text: The KSE-100 benchmark was at about 62,500 points when this food-sector review was recorded.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX: KSE 30 vs KSE 100 | Food Sector Snapshot 🔍' (YouTube, 2023-12-05)

fact_text: The analyst argued the KSE-30, a free-float index, is a better gauge of the market than the KSE-100 and suggested tracking its trend line.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX: KSE 30 vs KSE 100 | Food Sector Snapshot 🔍' (YouTube, 2023-12-05)

fact_text: For food companies the analyst preferred price-to-sales, sales per share and quarterly sales growth over price-to-earnings, because inflation is showing up in top-line growth.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX: KSE 30 vs KSE 100 | Food Sector Snapshot 🔍' (YouTube, 2023-12-05)

fact_text: Several local food companies were trading at a price-to-sales multiple below 1x, which the analyst pointed out as a screening point.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX: KSE 30 vs KSE 100 | Food Sector Snapshot 🔍' (YouTube, 2023-12-05)

fact_text: Value-added dairy products such as yogurt and ice cream earn much higher margins per litre of milk than selling plain milk, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX: KSE 30 vs KSE 100 | Food Sector Snapshot 🔍' (YouTube, 2023-12-05)

fact_text: Several once-strong food companies, including Mitchell's Fruit Farms, National Foods and Shezan, went through a downturn and the analyst said they are recovering.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX: KSE 30 vs KSE 100 | Food Sector Snapshot 🔍' (YouTube, 2023-12-05)

fact_text: Friesland Campina, formerly Engro Foods, grew its sales strongly and became a rival to Nestle, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX: KSE 30 vs KSE 100 | Food Sector Snapshot 🔍' (YouTube, 2023-12-05)

fact_text: Metro Foods began as a rice exporter and later moved into making sweeteners that it supplies to the bakery industry.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX: KSE 30 vs KSE 100 | Food Sector Snapshot 🔍' (YouTube, 2023-12-05)

fact_text: Al Tahur breeds Australian cattle to multiply its biological assets, grew sales on that base, and has spread its distribution from Kasur and Multan into Karachi.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX: KSE 30 vs KSE 100 | Food Sector Snapshot 🔍' (YouTube, 2023-12-05)

fact_text: Newer local food companies that entered exports earned exchange-rate gains, which the analyst said helped them grow fast.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX: KSE 30 vs KSE 100 | Food Sector Snapshot 🔍' (YouTube, 2023-12-05)

fact_text: The analyst said inflationary pressure is visible in the top-line sales growth of food companies as of late 2023.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'PSX: KSE 30 vs KSE 100 | Food Sector Snapshot 🔍' (YouTube, 2023-12-05)
